question: After the current-main port is done, should this PR stay scoped to direct WebChat Stop recovery and leave the compaction/restartRecoveryRuns variant to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97457?
rationale: The direct Stop bug has a focused fix path, but the adjacent compaction report shares session-state surfaces and only maintainers can decide whether this branch should remain narrow or absorb that broader race.

options.title: Keep Direct Stop Scope
options.body: Port and land the direct WebChat Stop recovery, while preserving the compaction report as a separate canonical follow-up.

options.title: Broaden Before Merge
options.body: Require this branch to add compaction/restartRecoveryRuns reproduction and regression coverage before it can land.

options.title: Pause For Unified Session Design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers choose a single stronger run-generation owner for Stop, compaction, and restart-recovery races.

recommendation.title: Keep Direct Stop Scope
recommendation.body: Port and land the direct WebChat Stop recovery, while preserving the compaction report as a separate canonical follow-up.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to the PR and already reviewed the central stale-run lifecycle invariant.
